map.标准 Amsler 方格为 10×10cm 等比网格（每格约 5mm），中心设一: A standard Amsler grid is a 10×10cm uniform grid (~5mm per cell) with a central red dot, used at home to monitor macula function. Wear your daily correction, test one eye at a time at ~30cm under good light, and mark any waviness, breaks or dark areas directly on the grid.
map.用手掌或眼罩遮住右眼，左眼注视中心红点，余光扫视四周方格。: Cover the right eye with your palm or patch; with the left eye fixate the central red dot and scan the surrounding grid.
map.标注左眼所见: Mark what the left eye sees
map.把左眼看到的任何扭曲、断裂、变大/变小或发暗区域画在网格上。: Draw any distortion, break, enlargement/shrinkage or darkening seen by the left eye on the grid.
map.换遮左眼，用右眼重复第 1、2 步，分别记录。: Switch to covering the left eye; repeat steps 1 and 2 with the right eye, recording separately.
map.保存本次快照，与历史快照并排对比，发现变化及时就医。: Save this snapshot and compare side by side with history; see a doctor if changes appear.
map.提示：点击「画区域」后在网格上依次落点勾出异常范围，双击或点「完成」闭合；「标点: Note: click 'Draw area' then place points on the grid to outline the abnormal range; double-click or click 'Done' to close; 'Mark point' is for scattered dark spots.
map.快照仅保存在你本机浏览器中，不会上传任何服务器。可任选两张做并排对比，观察黄斑区: Snapshots are stored only in your browser and never uploaded. Pick any two for side-by-side comparison to watch the macula region change.
map.暂无快照，测完一眼镜格后点击「保存本次快照」。: No snapshots yet; after testing one eye click "Save this snapshot".
map.本 Amsler 方格表仅用于黄斑功能的居家自我监测与科普，: This Amsler grid is only for home self-monitoring of macula function and education,
map.不能替代眼科医生的专业检查: and cannot replace a professional ophthalmologist's exam
map.。它无法发现青光眼、视网膜脱离早期、周边病变等许多眼病。若你发现方格出现新的扭曲: . It cannot detect glaucoma, early retinal detachment, peripheral lesions and many eye diseases. If you notice new waviness, bent lines, a central dark spot, or metamorphopsia (objects larger/smaller), or the two eyes differ, see an ophthalmologist promptly; do not delay because self-test was "normal". Those with diabetes, hypertension or family history of macular degeneration should get regular OCT and fundus exams.

map.居家用方格表自查黄斑功能（单眼交替、注视中央点）。: At home use the grid to self-check macula function (alternating eyes, fixating the center).
map.记录线条扭曲(metamorphopsia)、暗点(scotoma)及范围。: Record line waviness (metamorphopsia), dark spots (scotoma) and extent.
map.黄斑变性、黄斑水肿、中浆等随访对比。: Compare follow-ups of macular degeneration, macular edema, central serous chorioretinopathy, etc.
map.注视中央点时部分方格线呈波浪状，提示黄斑区轻度水肿或变性，建议尽快行 OCT 与: When fixating the center, some grid lines look wavy, suggesting mild macular edema or degeneration; get OCT and fundus exam soon.
map.中央出现固定暗点并随注视移动，需警惕黄斑病变活动期，应及时就诊评估。: A fixed central dark spot that moves with gaze signals active macular disease; seek prompt evaluation.
map.双眼同视可互相补偿，掩盖单眼黄斑异常；遮蔽一眼、另一眼单独注视更能发现早期病变。: Both eyes together compensate and hide one eye's macular abnormality; covering one eye and testing the other alone reveals early lesions.
map.已知黄斑病变者建议每周 1–2 次；健康人群可用于日常觉察，出现异常随时增加频率: Those with known macular disease: 1-2 times weekly; healthy people can self-monitor and increase frequency if anything appears.
